theme: A morning of calls, then the afternoon opens.
greeting: Back-to-back conversations fill the morning, Dan, and then the day is yours. A small stack of travel bookings has quietly slipped past due — good use of that open afternoon.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: Open on the Mike + Dan board since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out — a refundable hold now takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 Portland-to-St Pete window closes in two days; miss it and the off-week gap is gone until Christmas.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December trip

acts.line: The morning fills with back-to-back calls from half past nine straight through to lunch.
Everything clears after lunch — the afternoon runs open end to end.
The girls are in Florida tonight, so the evening is unclaimed and the kitchen's free.
